validation.description: Validation episodes are held out only from the configured TRAIN scenarios. TEST scenarios must never be used for training, validation, preprocessing fit, or hyperparameter selection.

baseline_training.provenance: Architecture and optimizer hyperparameters follow Ros1Data/ROS1_train/train.py and train_info.txt as a historical reference. Both new experiments use the current TorchModels ROS2 preprocessing and current ROS2 dataset; this is not claimed to be a bit-for-bit ROS1 reproduction.

normalization.occupancy_grid: current TorchModels preprocessing: raw LOM divided by 100 and clipped to [0, 1]
normalization.provenance: Keep current ROS2 TorchModels preprocessing. ROS1Data is comparison/reference material, not a training input.

baseline_training.architecture_note: The RNN implementation has its own fixed dropout layers; train.py's dropout CLI parameter is not wired into models.RNN and is omitted here.

A.description: Small training set and broad test set.

B.description: Broad training set and moderate test set.
